content: We-degigusad-sorbali, baliwitur-baid nibneggi-aidedani an daksad. Bela-belad gangued nikad. Baliwitur-sabsur-mee-gaedbali, napneg bela mee gaded.
Degine, we-baliwitur binnasuli goted. Weyob sogded:

content.text: Ar bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, galagwensuli we-Babilonia-isguedgi eba isgusmarmogad.

content: Geb degi, nibneggi gayaburba-baid gole an itosbalid. Weyob soged:

content.text: Ar Babilonia-dorgan-e-isgued dummarbasoggu, e-isgued nibnegse warmaksad,
degine, Bab-Dummad we-isgued gwen iessulid, bela ebinsasad.
Igi Babilonia-dorgan dulemar-baigan-imaksa, deyob be imakmo.
Gobedgi-aimar-ogobsadi, a-ilabo-wilub a-gobed ega be ukmo.
ayob gangu be odurdakmoga, deyob be obomosun.
Ar ade, Babilonia na e-gwagegi soged: ‘Ani an rey-omeyobi an siid,
Degisoggu, unnila ibagwen-abalakwaa e-bonigan egi yolenonikoed:
Burgwed egi nonikoed, boed egi nonikoed,
Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Igar-Nabogedid, bela-bela gangued nikad.”

content: Degine, we-napneggi-reyga-mamaid we-omeba-galagwensuli-negsichigi-nanadigusmalad, we-omeba-yeer-itodigusmalad, Babilonia-neg-gummakmaidba waa-bupurmakmai-dakarmalar, eba dummad-bomaloed, wile-itomaloed.
Reymar Babilonia-e-naibigunaidba dobed-ular egi bannaba gwisgumaloed, binnasur gotemaloed, sogdemaloed:
Degine, dulemar we-napneggi-ibmar-ukedgi-mani-onomalad ega nue-bomalad, nue-bukib binsamalad, ar ade, bar ese we-ibmarmar bakosurmalad:

content.text: Be-ibmar-nue-nikad-yeerdakleged be nikagusadi, bei bergussun, bar be gwen dakosulid.”

content: Ibmar-ukedgi-mani-onodigusmalad, we-ibmar-ukedgi mani-ibedga gusmalad. Wemar, Babilonia-neggwebur-sabsur-odurdaklenaid-dobed-ular, bannabaa gwisgumaloed, bobukwa, degi, bukib-binsabukwa ega gumaloed,

content.text: Ar unnila wachi-irgwengi bela be-ibmar-gargemalad bato surguus naded.”

content: Degine, bela sour-onanamalad, urgi-nanamalad, ur-selagan, degine, bela demargi-mani-onomalad, Babiloniaʼgi dikasur ambikusmalad.
Degine, neggwebur-gummakmaid-e-waa dakarmargua, binnasur gotemalad, sogdemalad: “¿Ibi-neggwebur weyob nue-nug-nika-sii gusbalinsunna?”
Degine, we-dulemar-neg-gummakmaid-dakbukmalad na e-nonogi ukub mismalad, oyogegar, emarde nue-bukib-binsamarye. Wemar binnasur gotemalad, ise-boar, ise-bukib-binsaar sogdemalad:

content.text: Babilonia, be mani-nue-nikadba bela dulemar-ur-demargi-nikamalad mani-ibedga be imaksad.
Emigindi, unnila wachi-irgwengi bela ibmar bato sate be gusad.

content: Degine, baliwitur-wargwen-dutusulid, akwa susad, akwamuu-dummadyobid. Geb demarse-metegu, sogded:

content.text: Babilonia, gala-arpa-ogormalad, gar-ogormalad, gammu-ogormalad, gala-trompeta-ogormalad, begi bar gwen itolegosulid.
Degine, galagwensuli ibmargi-arbamalad gwen bar daklegosurbalid,
degi, orsar bar gornai gwen itolegosurbalid.
Ar be-dulemar begi-mani-onomaladi, we-napneggi dule-dummagan guenad.
Ar be ina-isgana-imakedba, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad bese yardaklesmalad.
